notes.title: IT'S CLOSE BETA TIME! And, optimization is svck, our back hurt! But WE love it!
notes.content:
Oh my, oh my, 5 days, we only have 5 days to submit our game to join a GameDev Event, Our back hurt but eventually we are not winning yet, Son...

(We just realize that our Opening Video make the game unplayable and adding more bug to our game, this Video literally destroy any UI and animation after a few minute in game, and we regret it)

BUT, right after that [strike]suffering[/strike] [i][u][b]submitting days[/b][/u][/i], we work really hard to optimize our game. From 20 FPS in ultra setting to 40FPS in ultra setting (we play it through Unity Game engine) and we hope to invest more of this Frame Rate.

Beside that optimization, we also improve our in game graphic quality (My Ryzen 3 and RX 560 is screaming like a Mandrake from Harry Potter)
And, we really happy to share it with you guys.

[b]P.S[/b] : UI and Icons here are just a placeholder.

notes.title: We make something to accompany your Journey ahead.
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,
Been a few days since our last update, even tho this lack-of-content page looks like a dead fish, but worry not, we still working our best!

Ah yes, about the title, [b]"We Make Something..."[/b], we are currently working on some music, so player won't feel bored like a broken soul. This music player is a Vinyl Disc, of course, you'll need Gramophone to play it. BUT, you won't be able to use it till you craft it first. After you craft this Gramophone, you will need a Vinyl, of course we will give you an easy-to-find Vinyl for a starter, but if you want to listen more of our music, you will need to explore our world.
Anyway, here is this how the Gramophone looks like:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36053678/23d246306ffe79979cf5b025a98fc1a71bcceffa.jpg[/img]


And here is how the Vinyl looks like: 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36053678/b13ab5428c8fcd6ceabf4c585074bee2488a4ea1.jpg[/img]


And here is how we make our music:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36053678/e76fa6f9d97eac9970c3b76350db907f53cb04c4.jpg[/img]

For the next update, we will provide you with one from many music you will listen in your airship, stay tune!
These Vinyl consist of many genres, so expect some random vibe in your air ship!

Much love!
Catgames

notes.title: PROJECT D : HUMAN RISEN Devlog #4 || Update for our flying-bird Vehicle
notes.content:
[i]"I want to make this airship as player's home, a place where player can do anything to manage their belonging, rising some livestock, do some farming and even fishing. I want her "B I G", because she is the best"[/i] -Somebody said it and we love it.

--------------<.>---------------

Hello Everyone,

It's been a while since the last update, we encounter some problem due to this pandemic situation, I am terribly sorry about the lack amount of update to this game, but fear not, we continue to develop this game as best as we can!

And there it is, our update for our beloved airship, we haven't name it yet, we still have some time to finish her. need to re-design her "balloon" and her interior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36053678/19a3ff2c8ac08cd62fccfea83307eb2b72dea576.png[/img]

Oh and, we currently testing out our First Person to Third Person view transition for our game, we facing some issue with Arm Rig exported from blender, and we happy to tell you that it's already fix because, this hand not looking so good lol.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36053678/188c0e50de2101734528f96913a0b2c32a2beef7.jpg[/img]

And, that's all for today!
Stay healthy, stay hydrate, stay in your room if you have no important to do.

Much love!
Catgames
